purpose: P8.1 -- STRICT enriched few-shot, requested explicitly after the v0.1 multi-case result (documentation/P8_Jev_Kev_Local_Decision_Model_V0_1.md Sec.6ter) showed STRICT failing on nearly every nuanced adversarial case with only 5 worked examples. Adds: (1) a real DEMONSTRATION_SET distinct from the evaluation corpus, 3 examples per positive relation + 2 per adversarial subtype (24 total, up from 5), so STRICT no longer has to learn 5 outcome classes from 1 example each; (2) adversarial cases expanded from 1 to 3-4 paraphrases per category (19 total, up from 6), holding subject/object constant per category so phrasing is the only varying factor; (3) a 'positive_paraphrase' category (4 cases) testing genuine structural generalization -- demonstrations all use 'X est la RELATION de Y', these evaluation cases use a different syntactic structure ('La RELATION de Y s'appelle X') never shown in any demonstration, to distinguish H1 (memorized surface pattern) from H2 (genuine relation abstraction). Every demonstration-set entity is verified disjoint from every evaluation-set entity by a dedicated test (tests/test_m7_jev_benchmark_v0_2.py) -- not just asserted here.
